name: Go on a wild goose chase

meaning.zh:
“徒劳无功的追寻” 或 “白费功夫的寻找”。

这个短语最早起源于16世纪的英国文学，意指追赶野生鹅是徒劳无功的，因为它们飞行的方向变化无常且不可预测。因此，这个短语被用来形容那些耗费时间和精力却没有任何结果的行动。
meaning.en: This phrase originally comes from 16th-century English literature, signifying that chasing wild geese is futile because of their unpredictable flight patterns. As a result, it describes actions that waste time and effort without any fruitful outcome.

lines.en: We went on a wild goose chase trying to find that old book.
lines.zh: 我们白费功夫地寻找那本旧书。

lines.en: She sent me on a wild goose chase looking for that nonexistent restaurant.
lines.zh: 她让我费尽心力去找那不存在的餐馆。

lines.en: Following that clue turned out to be a wild goose chase.
lines.zh: 追寻那个线索结果是徒劳无功的。
